vi.R: Phi-lát nói với họ lần thứ ba: "Tại sao? Người này đã làm gì sai?

ko.L: 빌라도가 세 번째로 그들에게 말했다. "도대체 이 사람이 무슨 악한 일을 했느냐?
ko.B: 빌라도가 세 번째로 그들에게 말했다. "어째서냐? 이 사람이 무슨 죄를 지었느냐?
ko.R: 빌라도가 세 번째로 그들에게 말했다. "왜? 이 사람이 무슨 나쁜 짓을 했느냐?

decisions.choice: a third time: Pilate's third verdict of innocence
alternatives: a third speech of any kind
decisions.reason: Luke counts the times: 23:4, 23:14-15 and now here. The repetition makes clear that Jesus was condemned though the judge found him innocent.

decisions.choice: Why: surprise or protest
decisions.reason: The small word in the question expresses surprise: "Why, what has he done?"

decisions.choice: Pilate
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker.

decisions.choice: The question as in the Korean Mark 15:14
decisions.reason: The Greek of Pilate's question is the same in Mark 15:14 apart from "this man", so the Korean reads alike.

source.text: οὐδὲν αἴτιον θανάτου εὗρον ἐν αὐτῷ· παιδεύσας οὖν αὐτὸν ἀπολύσω.

records.literal_gloss: No cause of death I found in him; having punished therefore him I will release.

en.L: I have found in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} no cause for death; therefore I will punish {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and release [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}]."
en.B: I have found no reason to put {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to death. So I will have {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} flogged and then let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} go."
en.R: I have found nothing that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} should die for. So I will have {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} whipped, and then I will let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} go free."

es.L: Ninguna causa de muerte he hallado en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; así que, después de castigarlo, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} soltaré».
es.B: No he encontrado ningún motivo para condenarlo a muerte. Así que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} haré azotar y luego {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} soltaré».
es.R: No he encontrado nada por lo que deba morir. Así que voy a mandar que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} azoten, y después {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} dejaré libre».

fr.L: Je n’ai trouvé en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aucun motif [de peine de] mort ; je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} châtierai donc et [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] relâcherai. »
fr.B: Je n’ai trouvé aucune raison de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettre à mort. Je vais donc {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire flageller, puis je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} relâcherai. »
fr.R: Je n’ai trouvé aucune raison de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire mourir. Alors je vais {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire frapper à coups de fouet, et puis je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} laisserai partir. »

sw.L: Sikuona ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} sababu yoyote ya kifo; basi, nikiisha kumwadhibu, nitamfungua."
sw.B: Sikuona sababu yoyote ya kumhukumu kifo. Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi, kisha nitamwachilia."
sw.R: Sijaona kosa lolote analostahili kufa kwa ajili yake. Kwa hiyo nitaagiza achapwe viboko, kisha nitamwachilia huru."

vi.L: Tôi không thấy nơi ông ta có tội gì đáng chết; vậy tôi sẽ trừng phạt ông ta rồi tha [ông ta]."
vi.B: Tôi không tìm thấy lý do gì để xử tử ông ta. Vậy tôi sẽ cho đánh đòn ông ta rồi thả ra."
vi.R: Tôi không thấy ông ta làm điều gì đáng phải chết. Vì vậy, tôi sẽ cho lính lấy roi đánh ông ta, rồi thả ông ta ra."

ko.L: 나는 그에게서 죽일 만한 죄를 아무것도 찾지 못했다. 그러므로 나는 그를 징계하고 놓아주겠다."
ko.B: 나는 그에게서 사형에 처할 만한 죄를 찾지 못했다. 그러니 그를 매질하게 한 뒤에 풀어 주겠다."
ko.R: 나는 이 사람이 죽어야 할 이유를 하나도 찾지 못했다. 그러니 이 사람을 매로 때리게 한 다음에 풀어 주겠다."

decisions.choice: cause of death: a crime that deserves the death penalty
decisions.reason: The same legal word as in 23:4 and 23:14, now with "of death": nothing he has done calls for execution.

decisions.choice: punish: a beating as a warning
alternatives: the scourging that came before crucifixion
decisions.reason: Pilate repeats his offer of 23:16.

decisions.choice: have him flogged (B); have him whipped (R)
decisions.reason: As in 23:16.

decisions.choice: aucun motif [de peine de] mort
decisions.reason: French "cause de mort" means what makes someone die, a medical sense; Literal supplies the words that make it a ground for the death penalty (m1).

source.text: οἱ δὲ ἐπέκειντο φωναῖς μεγάλαις αἰτούμενοι αὐτὸν σταυρωθῆναι, καὶ κατίσχυον αἱ φωναὶ αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: They but were pressing with voices loud asking him to be crucified, and were prevailing the voices of them.

en.L: But they kept pressing [him] with loud voices, demanding that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} be crucified, and their voices prevailed.
en.B: But they pressed their demand with loud shouts, calling for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be crucified, and their shouting won the day.
en.R: But they kept shouting loudly. They demanded that Jesus be put to death on a cross. In the end their shouting won.

es.L: Pero ellos [le] insistían con grandes voces, pidiendo que fuera crucificado; y las voces de ellos se imponían.
es.B: Pero ellos insistieron a gritos, exigiendo que fuera crucificado, y sus gritos se impusieron.
es.R: Pero ellos siguieron gritando con fuerza. Exigían que mataran a Jesús en una cruz. Al final, sus gritos ganaron.

fr.L: Mais ils insistaient à grands cris, demandant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit crucifié, et leurs voix l’emportaient.
fr.B: Mais ils redoublaient leurs cris pour exiger qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit crucifié, et leurs cris finirent par l’emporter.
fr.R: Mais ils continuaient à crier très fort. Ils exigeaient qu’on cloue Jésus sur une croix. À la fin, à force de crier, ils ont gagné.

sw.L: Lakini wao wakazidi kumsisitiza kwa sauti kubwa, wakitaka asulubiwe; na sauti zao zikashinda.
sw.B: Lakini wao walikaza madai yao kwa kelele nyingi, wakidai asulubiwe, na kelele zao zikashinda.
sw.R: Lakini waliendelea kupiga kelele kwa nguvu. Walidai Yesu auawe msalabani. Mwishowe kelele zao zilishinda.

vi.L: Nhưng họ cứ lớn tiếng nài ép, đòi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải bị đóng đinh, và tiếng la của họ thắng thế.
vi.B: Nhưng họ cứ la to, một mực đòi đóng đinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tiếng la hét của họ đã thắng.
vi.R: Nhưng họ cứ la thật to. Họ đòi phải đóng đinh Đức Giê-xu trên cây thập tự. Cuối cùng tiếng la hét của họ đã thắng.

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 큰 소리로 그분을 십자가에 못 박으라고 요구하며 계속 다그쳤다. 그리고 그들의 소리가 이겼다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 예수를 십자가에 못 박으라고 큰 소리로 끈질기게 요구했다. 결국 그들의 외침이 이겼다.
ko.R: 그러나 사람들은 계속 큰 소리로 외쳤다. 예수를 십자가에 못 박으라고 요구했다. 결국 그들이 고집한 대로 되었다.

decisions.choice: pressing: insisting, bearing down on Pilate
decisions.reason: The verb means to lie on or press upon. It pictures the crowd pushing Pilate to give way.

decisions.choice: prevailed: overpowered all resistance
decisions.reason: The verb means to be strong enough to win; the same verb is used of the gates of Hades in Matthew 16:18.

decisions.choice: their voices: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: their voices and those of the chief priests, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "and those of the chief priests". The early papyrus P75, Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus do not have the words. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

source.text: καὶ Πιλᾶτος ἐπέκρινεν γενέσθαι τὸ αἴτημα αὐτῶν·

records.literal_gloss: and Pilate decided to be done the demand of them;

en.L: And Pilate gave sentence that their demand be carried out.
en.B: So Pilate ruled that what they asked for should be done.
en.R: So Pilate decided to give them what they wanted.

es.L: Y Pilato sentenció que se hiciera lo que ellos pedían.
es.B: Así que Pilato resolvió que se hiciera lo que pedían.
es.R: Entonces Pilato decidió darles lo que querían.

fr.L: Et Pilate prononça que leur demande soit accomplie.
fr.B: Pilate ordonna donc que leur demande soit satisfaite.
fr.R: Alors Pilate a décidé de leur donner ce qu’ils voulaient.

sw.L: Naye Pilato akatoa hukumu kwamba ombi lao litimizwe.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo Pilato aliamua kwamba walichokiomba kifanyike.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Pilato aliamua kuwapa walichotaka.

vi.L: Và Phi-lát phán quyết cho điều họ đòi được thực hiện.
vi.B: Vậy Phi-lát quyết định làm theo điều họ đòi.
vi.R: Vậy Phi-lát quyết định chiều theo ý họ.

ko.L: 그래서 빌라도는 그들의 요구대로 되도록 판결했다.
ko.B: 그리하여 빌라도는 그들이 요구한 대로 하라고 판결을 내렸다.
ko.R: 그래서 빌라도는 그들이 원하는 대로 해 주기로 했다.

decisions.choice: gave sentence: made a formal ruling
decisions.reason: The verb is used for a judge's decision. Pilate acts as judge and decides the case against his own verdict.

decisions.choice: a raised dot: the sentence runs on into 23:25
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT marks a pause here; the next sentence describes what the ruling meant. Every level ends the sentence here.

decisions.choice: "phán quyết" (L)
decisions.reason: The legal word for a judge's formal ruling (meaning decision); it is not the verb "phán" kept for God speaking.

source.text: ἀπέλυσεν δὲ τὸν διὰ στάσιν καὶ φόνον βεβλημένον εἰς φυλακὴν ὃν ᾐτοῦντο, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν παρέδωκεν τῷ θελήματι αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: He released then the [one] because of uprising and murder having been thrown into prison whom they were asking for, the and Jesus he handed over to the will of them.

en.L: And he released the one who had been thrown into prison for uprising and murder, whom they were asking for, but Jesus he handed over to their will.
en.B: He set free the man they asked for, the one who had been put in prison for revolt and murder. But Jesus he gave up to them to do as they wished.
en.R: He set free the man they wanted, the one who was in prison for rebellion and murder. But he handed Jesus over to them to do whatever they wanted.

es.L: Y soltó al que había sido echado en la cárcel por revuelta y homicidio, al que pedían, pero a Jesús lo entregó a la voluntad de ellos.
es.B: Dejó libre al hombre que ellos pedían, el que había sido encarcelado por rebelión y asesinato. Pero a Jesús se lo entregó a ellos para que hicieran con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo que quisieran.
es.R: Dejó libre al hombre que querían, al que estaba en la cárcel por rebelión y asesinato. Pero a Jesús se lo entregó para que hicieran con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todo lo que quisieran.

fr.L: Et il relâcha celui qui avait été jeté en prison pour émeute et meurtre, celui qu’ils réclamaient, mais Jésus, il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livra à leur volonté.
fr.B: Il libéra l’homme qu’ils réclamaient, celui qui avait été mis en prison pour révolte et meurtre. Quant à Jésus, il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} leur livra pour qu’ils fassent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ce qu’ils voulaient.
fr.R: Il a libéré l’homme qu’ils voulaient, celui qui était en prison pour révolte et pour meurtre. Mais il leur a livré Jésus, pour qu’ils fassent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ce qu’ils voulaient.

sw.L: Akamfungua yule aliyekuwa ametupwa gerezani kwa ajili ya uasi na mauaji, ambaye walikuwa wakimwomba; lakini Yesu akamkabidhi kwa mapenzi yao.
sw.B: Alimwachilia yule mtu waliyemwomba, aliyekuwa ametiwa gerezani kwa uasi na mauaji. Lakini Yesu akamkabidhi kwao wamfanyie walivyotaka.
sw.R: Alimwachilia huru mtu waliyemtaka, yule aliyekuwa gerezani kwa uasi na mauaji. Lakini Yesu akamkabidhi kwao, wamfanye lolote walilotaka.

vi.L: Ông tha kẻ đã bị bỏ vào ngục vì nổi loạn và giết người, là kẻ họ đã xin, còn Đức Giê-xu thì ông nộp theo ý muốn của họ.
vi.B: Ông thả người mà họ xin, là kẻ đã bị bỏ tù vì tội nổi loạn và giết người. Còn Đức Giê-xu thì ông nộp cho họ, để họ làm theo ý họ muốn.
vi.R: Ông thả người mà họ muốn, là kẻ đang ở tù vì tội nổi loạn và giết người. Còn Đức Giê-xu thì ông nộp cho họ, để họ muốn làm gì thì làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 반란과 살인 때문에 감옥에 던져진 자, 곧 그들이 요구하던 자를 놓아주고, 예수는 그들의 뜻에 넘겨주었다.
ko.B: 빌라도는 폭동과 살인 때문에 감옥에 갇혀 있던 사람, 곧 그들이 요구한 사람을 풀어 주었다. 그리고 예수는 그들의 뜻대로 하도록 넘겨주었다.
ko.R: 빌라도는 폭동과 살인 때문에 감옥에 갇혀 있던 사람을 풀어 주었다. 사람들이 풀어 달라고 한 사람이었다. 그리고 예수는 사람들 뜻대로 하도록 그들에게 넘겨주었다.

decisions.choice: the guilty man released: Luke repeats Barabbas's crimes
decisions.reason: Luke says again why Barabbas was in prison. The rebel and murderer goes free while the innocent one is condemned (Acts 3:14).

decisions.choice: handed over: as Jesus had foretold
decisions.reason: Jesus had said that the Son of Man would be handed over into the hands of men (9:44) and to the Gentiles (18:32). The same verb is used here.

decisions.choice: to their will: to do with him as they wanted
decisions.reason: Pilate gives them what they demand. Roman soldiers carry out the sentence (23:36), but the will that is done is theirs.

decisions.choice: entregó (every level)
decisions.reason: The verb of Jesus's own predictions that he would be handed over (meaning decision m2). Spanish keeps "entregar" for every handing over of Jesus, as in Matthew 27 and Mark 15.

decisions.choice: akamkabidhi (every level)
decisions.reason: The verb of Jesus's own predictions that he would be handed over (meaning decision m2). Swahili keeps "kukabidhi" for every handing over of Jesus, as in John 19, Matthew 27 and Mark 15.

decisions.choice: "nộp" for "handed over"
decisions.reason: The verb of Jesus' predictions (Luke 9:44) and of the passion story in the Vietnamese Mark 15:1, kept as one Vietnamese verb so the echo stays (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "넘겨주다" for paradidomi at every level
decisions.reason: The verb of Jesus' predictions that he would be handed over (meaning decision), as in the Korean Mark 15:15 and Luke 9:44.

source.text: Καὶ ὡς ἀπήγαγον αὐτόν, ἐπιλαβόμενοι Σίμωνά τινα Κυρηναῖον ἐρχόμενον ἀπ’ ἀγροῦ ἐπέθηκαν αὐτῷ τὸν σταυρὸν φέρειν ὄπισθεν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And as they led away him, having seized Simon a certain Cyrenian coming from [the] country they put on him the cross to carry behind the Jesus.

en.L: And as they led {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} away, they seized a certain Simon, a Cyrenian, coming from the country, and put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
en.B: As they led {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} away, they took hold of a man named Simon from Cyrene, who was coming in from the countryside. They laid the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
en.R: The soldiers led Jesus away. On the way they grabbed a man named Simon, from the city of Cyrene in Africa. He was coming into Jerusalem from the fields. They put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.

es.L: Y cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaban, echaron mano de un tal Simón, cireneo, que venía del campo, y le pusieron encima la cruz para que la llevara detrás de Jesús.
es.B: Mientras {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaban, agarraron a un hombre de Cirene llamado Simón, que venía del campo. Le cargaron la cruz y lo obligaron a llevarla detrás de Jesús.
es.R: Los soldados se llevaron a Jesús. En el camino agarraron a un hombre llamado Simón, de la ciudad de Cirene, en África. Simón venía a Jerusalén desde el campo. Le pusieron la cruz encima y lo obligaron a cargarla detrás de Jesús.

fr.L: Et comme ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}emmenaient, ils saisirent un certain Simon, un Cyrénéen, qui venait des champs, et ils le chargèrent de la croix pour la porter derrière Jésus.
fr.B: Pendant qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}emmenaient, ils s’emparèrent d’un homme de Cyrène nommé Simon, qui arrivait de la campagne. Ils le chargèrent de la croix et l’obligèrent à la porter derrière Jésus.
fr.R: Les soldats ont emmené Jésus. En chemin, ils ont attrapé un homme appelé Simon, qui venait de la ville de Cyrène, en Afrique. Il arrivait des champs et entrait dans Jérusalem. Ils l’ont chargé de la croix et l’ont obligé à la porter derrière Jésus.

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wakimpeleka, walimkamata Simoni fulani Mkirene, aliyekuwa akija kutoka shambani, wakamtwika msalaba aubebe nyuma ya Yesu.
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakimpeleka, walimkamata mtu mmoja wa Kirene aitwaye Simoni, aliyekuwa akitoka shambani. Wakamtwika msalaba, wakamlazimisha aubebe nyuma ya Yesu.
sw.R: Askari walimchukua Yesu. Njiani walimkamata mtu mmoja aitwaye Simoni, wa mji wa Kirene huko Afrika. Alikuwa akija Yerusalemu kutoka mashambani. Wakamtwika msalaba, wakamlazimisha aubebe nyuma ya Yesu.

vi.L: Khi họ dẫn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi, họ bắt một người tên Si-môn, người Sy-ren, đang từ ngoài đồng về, và đặt cây thập tự trên ông để vác theo sau Đức Giê-xu.
vi.B: Khi dẫn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi, họ bắt một người tên là Si-môn, quê ở Sy-ren, đang từ ngoài đồng vào thành. Họ đặt cây thập tự lên vai ông và bắt ông vác đi theo sau Đức Giê-xu.
vi.R: Những người lính dẫn Đức Giê-xu đi. Dọc đường họ bắt một người tên là Si-môn, quê ở thành Sy-ren, ở Bắc Phi. Ông đang từ ngoài đồng đi vào Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ đặt cây thập tự lên vai ông và bắt ông vác đi sau Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그분을 끌고 갈 때에, 시골에서 오고 있던 구레네 사람 시몬이라는 어떤 사람을 붙잡아, 그에게 십자가를 지워 예수의 뒤에서 지고 가게 했다.
ko.B: 그들은 예수를 끌고 가다가, 시골에서 들어오던 구레네 사람 시몬을 붙잡았다. 그리고 그에게 십자가를 지워 예수의 뒤를 따라가게 했다.
ko.R: 병사들이 예수를 끌고 갔다. 가는 길에 그들은 시몬이라는 사람을 붙잡았다. 그는 북아프리카의 구레네에서 온 사람이었는데, 밭에서 성안으로 들어오고 있었다. 병사들은 시몬에게 십자가를 지우고 예수의 뒤에서 지고 가게 했다.

decisions.choice: a Cyrenian: from Cyrene in North Africa
decisions.reason: Cyrene was a city in what is now Libya, with a large Jewish community; Jews from Cyrene were in Jerusalem at Pentecost (Acts 2:10; 6:9). Mark 15:21 names Simon's sons, Alexander and Rufus.

decisions.choice: they seized him and put the cross on him
decisions.reason: A condemned man usually carried his own cross, or its crossbeam, to the place of execution. Roman soldiers could force a passer-by to carry a load (Matthew 5:41).

decisions.choice: to carry behind Jesus: the picture of a disciple
alternatives: only a note of the order of the procession
decisions.reason: Luke's wording recalls Jesus' call to take up one's cross and come after him (9:23; 14:27).

decisions.choice: the country: the fields outside the city
alternatives: his farm, where he had been working
decisions.reason: The word means the countryside. Luke does not say why Simon had been there.

decisions.choice: The soldiers
decisions.reason: Readable names who led Jesus away; Luke mentions the soldiers in 23:36.

decisions.choice: "Sy-ren"; "cây thập tự"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms used in the Vietnamese Mark 15:21 and John 19:17.

decisions.choice: "구레네" as in the Korean Mark 15:21; "예수의 뒤에서" / "뒤를 따라" for "behind Jesus"
decisions.reason: Carrying the cross behind Jesus is the picture of a disciple (meaning decision, Luke 9:23 "자기 십자가를 지고 나를 따라야"); every level keeps "behind" so the echo is heard.

source.text: Ἠκολούθει δὲ αὐτῷ πολὺ πλῆθος τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ γυναικῶν αἳ ἐκόπτοντο καὶ ἐθρήνουν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Were following now him a great multitude of the people and of women who were beating themselves and lamenting him.

en.L: And a great multitude of the people followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and of women who were beating their breasts and lamenting for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: A large crowd of the people followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, among them women who were mourning and wailing for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: A large crowd of people followed Jesus. Among them were women who were crying and beating their chests in sorrow for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguía una gran multitud del pueblo y de mujeres que se golpeaban el pecho y se lamentaban por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Una gran multitud del pueblo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguía, y entre ellos había mujeres que lloraban y se lamentaban por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Mucha gente seguía a Jesús. Entre ellos había mujeres que lloraban y se golpeaban el pecho de tristeza por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et une grande multitude du peuple {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivait, et de femmes qui se frappaient la poitrine et se lamentaient sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Une grande foule du peuple {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivait, et parmi elle des femmes qui menaient le deuil et se lamentaient sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Une grande foule de gens suivait Jésus. Parmi eux, il y avait des femmes. Elles pleuraient sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et se frappaient la poitrine de tristesse.

sw.L: Na umati mkubwa wa watu ulikuwa ukimfuata, na wa wanawake waliokuwa wakijipiga vifua na kumwombolezea.
sw.B: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulimfuata, na miongoni mwao walikuwa wanawake waliokuwa wakiomboleza na kumlilia.
sw.R: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulimfuata Yesu. Miongoni mwao walikuwa wanawake waliokuwa wakilia na kujipiga vifua kwa huzuni kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Có một đoàn dân rất đông đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cùng những người phụ nữ đấm ngực và than khóc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Một đoàn dân đông đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trong đó có những người phụ nữ khóc than thương tiếc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Một đám đông rất lớn đi theo Đức Giê-xu. Trong đó có những người phụ nữ vừa khóc vừa đấm ngực vì thương xót {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 백성의 큰 무리와 여자들이 그분을 따라갔다. 그 여자들은 그분을 위하여 가슴을 치며 슬피 울고 있었다.
ko.B: 많은 백성이 예수를 따라갔다. 그 가운데는 예수를 위하여 가슴을 치며 통곡하는 여자들도 있었다.
ko.R: 많은 사람이 예수를 따라갔다. 그 가운데에는 여자들도 있었는데, 그들은 예수 때문에 슬퍼하며 가슴을 치고 울었다.

decisions.choice: beating their breasts and lamenting: the public mourning for the dead
decisions.reason: Mourners struck their chests and wailed aloud, as at the death of Jairus's daughter (8:52). The women mourn Jesus as one already dead.

decisions.choice: a great multitude of the people: the people are not all against him
alternatives: the crowd that shouted for his death
decisions.reason: Luke sets the people who follow and mourn beside the leaders who condemn. At the cross the people watch while the rulers mock (23:35), and the crowds go home grieving (23:48).

decisions.choice: mourning
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the general word for the act of mourning; Literal and Readable show the gesture.

source.text: στραφεὶς δὲ πρὸς αὐτὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Θυγατέρες Ἰερουσαλήμ, μὴ κλαίετε ἐπ’ ἐμέ· πλὴν ἐφ’ ἑαυτὰς κλαίετε καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἔρχονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς ἐροῦσιν Μακάριαι αἱ στεῖραι καὶ αἱ κοιλίαι αἳ οὐκ ἐγέννησαν καὶ μαστοὶ οἳ οὐκ ἔθρεψαν.

records.literal_gloss: Having turned then to them the Jesus said, Daughters of Jerusalem, not weep for me; but for yourselves weep and for the children of you, \v 29 for behold are coming days in which they will say, Blessed the barren and the wombs that not bore and breasts that not nursed.

en.L: And Jesus turned to them and said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; rather weep for yourselves and for your children, \v 29 for look, days are coming in which they will say, 'Blessed [are] the barren, and the wombs that did not bear, and the breasts that did not nurse.'
en.B: Jesus turned toward them and said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, it is not {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} you should be weeping over. Weep over yourselves and over your children. \v 29 Days are coming when people will say, 'Blessed are the women who could not have children, the wombs that never gave birth and the breasts that never fed a baby.'
en.R: Jesus turned to the women and said, "Women of Jerusalem, do not cry for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Cry for yourselves and for your children. \v 29 A time is coming when people will say, 'Blessed are the women who never had children. Blessed are those who never gave birth and never fed a baby at the breast.'

es.L: Y, volviéndose hacia ellas, Jesús dijo: «Hijas de Jerusalén, no {{plural_you:lloren|lloréis}} por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; más bien {{plural_you:lloren|llorad}} por {{plural_you:ustedes mismas|vosotras mismas}} y por {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}}, \v 29 porque {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, vienen días en que dirán: “Dichosas las estériles, y los vientres que no dieron a luz, y los pechos que no amamantaron”.
es.B: Jesús se volvió hacia ellas y les dijo: «Hijas de Jerusalén, no es por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} por quien {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} llorar. {{plural_you:Lloren|Llorad}} por {{plural_you:ustedes mismas|vosotras mismas}} y por {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}}. \v 29 Vienen días en que la gente dirá: “Dichosas las mujeres que no pudieron tener hijos, los vientres que nunca dieron a luz y los pechos que nunca alimentaron a un niño”.
es.R: Jesús se volvió hacia las mujeres y les dijo: «Mujeres de Jerusalén, no {{plural_you:lloren|lloréis}} por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. {{plural_you:Lloren|Llorad}} por {{plural_you:ustedes mismas|vosotras mismas}} y por {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}}. \v 29 Va a llegar un tiempo en que la gente dirá: “Dichosas las mujeres que nunca tuvieron hijos. Dichosas las que nunca dieron a luz ni dieron el pecho a un bebé”.

fr.L: Et s’étant tourné vers elles, Jésus dit : « Filles de Jérusalem, ne pleurez pas sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; pleurez plutôt sur vous-mêmes et sur vos enfants, \v 29 car voici, des jours viennent où l’on dira : “Heureuses les stériles, et les ventres qui n’ont pas enfanté, et les seins qui n’ont pas nourri !”
fr.B: Jésus se tourna vers elles et dit : « Filles de Jérusalem, ce n’est pas sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’il faut pleurer. Pleurez sur vous-mêmes et sur vos enfants. \v 29 Des jours viennent où l’on dira : “Heureuses les femmes stériles, les ventres qui n’ont jamais enfanté et les seins qui n’ont jamais allaité !”
fr.R: Jésus s’est tourné vers les femmes et leur a dit : « Femmes de Jérusalem, ne pleurez pas sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Pleurez sur vous-mêmes et sur vos enfants. \v 29 Un temps va venir où les gens diront : “Heureuses les femmes qui n’ont jamais eu d’enfants ! Heureuses celles qui n’ont jamais mis d’enfant au monde et qui n’ont jamais allaité de bébé !”

sw.L: Naye Yesu, akiwageukia, alisema, "Mabinti wa Yerusalemu, msilie kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; bali lieni kwa ajili yenu wenyewe na ya watoto wenu, \v 29 kwa sababu tazama, siku zinakuja ambazo watasema, 'Heri wanawake wagumba, na matumbo ambayo hayakuzaa, na matiti ambayo hayakunyonyesha.'
sw.B: Yesu aliwageukia, akasema, "Mabinti wa Yerusalemu, si {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} mnayepaswa kunililia. Lieni kwa ajili yenu wenyewe na kwa ajili ya watoto wenu. \v 29 Siku zinakuja ambapo watu watasema, 'Heri wanawake wasioweza kuzaa, matumbo ambayo hayajapata kuzaa, na matiti ambayo hayajapata kunyonyesha mtoto.'
sw.R: Yesu aliwageukia wale wanawake, akasema, "Wanawake wa Yerusalemu, msinililie {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Lieni kwa ajili yenu wenyewe na kwa ajili ya watoto wenu. \v 29 Wakati unakuja ambapo watu watasema, 'Heri wanawake ambao hawakupata watoto kamwe. Heri wale ambao hawakuzaa kamwe wala kunyonyesha mtoto.'

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu quay lại phía họ và nói: "Hỡi các con gái Giê-ru-sa-lem, đừng khóc cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; nhưng hãy khóc cho chính các con và cho con cái các con, \v 29 vì kìa, những ngày sẽ đến, trong những ngày ấy người ta sẽ nói: 'Phước cho những người son sẻ, những dạ chưa từng sinh nở và những bầu vú chưa từng cho bú!'
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu quay lại nói với họ: "Hỡi các con gái Giê-ru-sa-lem, đừng khóc cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy khóc cho chính các con và cho con cái các con. \v 29 Vì sắp đến những ngày người ta sẽ nói: 'Phước cho những người phụ nữ son sẻ, cho những dạ không hề sinh nở và những bầu ngực không hề cho con bú!'
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu quay lại nói với những người phụ nữ ấy: "Hỡi phụ nữ Giê-ru-sa-lem, đừng khóc cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy khóc cho chính các con và cho con cái các con. \v 29 Sắp đến lúc người ta sẽ nói: 'Phước cho những người phụ nữ không có con. Phước cho những người chưa bao giờ sinh con và chưa bao giờ cho con bú!'

ko.L: 예수께서 그들에게로 돌아서서 말씀하셨다. "예루살렘의 딸들아, 나를 위하여 울지 마라. 오히려 너희 자신과 너희 자녀들을 위하여 울어라. \v 29 보라, 사람들이 '임신하지 못하는 여자들과, 낳아 보지 못한 태와, 젖을 먹여 보지 못한 가슴은 복이 있다' 하고 말할 날들이 오고 있기 때문이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그 여자들을 돌아보시며 말씀하셨다. "예루살렘의 딸들아, 나를 위하여 울지 마라. 너희 자신과 너희 자녀들을 위하여 울어라. \v 29 사람들이 '아이를 낳지 못하는 여자들은 복이 있다. 아기를 낳아 보지 못한 태와 젖을 먹여 보지 못한 가슴은 복이 있다' 하고 말할 날이 올 것이다.
ko.R: 예수께서 여자들 쪽으로 돌아서서 말씀하셨다. "예루살렘의 여자들아, 나 때문에 울지 마라. 너희 자신과 너희 아이들 때문에 울어라. \v 29 사람들이 이렇게 말하게 될 때가 오고 있다. '아이를 낳지 못한 여자들은 복이 있다. 아기를 낳아 본 적도, 젖을 먹여 본 적도 없는 여자들은 복이 있다.'

decisions.choice: Daughters of Jerusalem: the women of the city
decisions.reason: The phrase is a way of addressing the women as belonging to the city, as Scripture speaks of the daughter of Zion (Zechariah 9:9). What he says is about Jerusalem as a whole.

decisions.choice: days are coming: the coming disaster for Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Jesus had wept over the city and foretold its destruction (19:41-44), and had said how hard those days would be for women who were pregnant or nursing (21:20-24).

decisions.choice: blessed are the barren: a reversal of what is normally said
alternatives: a blessing on not having children in general
decisions.reason: To be childless was usually a grief (1:25). In the coming disaster it would be better to have no children to watch suffer.

decisions.choice: they will say: people in general
alternatives: the women he is speaking to
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject; it means what people will be saying in those days.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Jesus uses this word to draw attention to the warning. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: Women of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom.

decisions.choice: Dichosas (every level)
decisions.reason: The word set for "blessed" (makarios) across these drafts. Here it turns the usual blessing upside down (meaning decision m3): in those days women without children will be the ones called fortunate.

decisions.choice: Heureuses, feminine, at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek adjective is feminine and the words are about women, so French makes it agree; "Heureux" is the form of the beatitudes in 6:20-22, which this saying turns upside down (m3). "L’on dira" (L, B), "les gens diront" (R) give the general "they" (m4).

decisions.choice: Jesus to the women: "các con"; "các con gái Giê-ru-sa-lem" (L, B), "phụ nữ Giê-ru-sa-lem" (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus addresses the women of the city (meaning decision) with the caring "các con" he uses for those who follow him; Readable says plainly who they are, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Phước cho"; "người son sẻ" for the barren
decisions.reason: "Phước cho" as in the Vietnamese Luke 6:20-23; "son sẻ" is the plain word for a woman who cannot bear children.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks to the women in 해라체; "예루살렘의 딸들아" (L, B), "예루살렘의 여자들아" (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks in the plain style to everyone (style guide, section 4); "딸들" keeps the Hebrew idiom for the women of the city (meaning decision), which Readable says plainly.

decisions.choice: "복이 있다" for makariai
decisions.reason: The word of the Korean Beatitudes (Matthew 5, Luke 6), so the reversal (meaning decision) is heard.

source.text: τότε ἄρξονται λέγειν τοῖς ὄρεσιν· Πέσετε ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς, καὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς· Καλύψατε ἡμᾶς·

records.literal_gloss: Then they will begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us, and to the hills, Cover us;

en.L: Then they will begin to say to the mountains, 'Fall on us,' and to the hills, 'Cover us.'
en.B: Then they will start saying to the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and to the hills, 'Cover us!'
en.R: People will call out to the mountains, 'Fall on us!' They will cry to the hills, 'Cover us up!'

es.L: Entonces comenzarán a decir a los montes: “{{plural_you:Caigan|Caed}} sobre nosotros”, y a las colinas: “{{plural_you:Cúbrannos|Cubridnos}}”.
es.B: Entonces empezarán a decirles a los montes: “¡{{plural_you:Caigan|Caed}} sobre nosotros!”, y a las colinas: “¡{{plural_you:Cúbrannos|Cubridnos}}!”.
es.R: La gente les gritará a los montes: “¡{{plural_you:Caigan|Caed}} sobre nosotros!”. Les gritará a las colinas: “¡{{plural_you:Tápennos|Tapadnos}}!”.

fr.L: Alors ils commenceront à dire aux montagnes : “Tombez sur nous !” et aux collines : “Couvrez-nous !”
fr.B: Alors on se mettra à dire aux montagnes : “Tombez sur nous !” et aux collines : “Couvrez-nous !”
fr.R: Les gens crieront aux montagnes : “Tombez sur nous !” Ils crieront aux collines : “Recouvrez-nous !”

sw.L: Wakati huo wataanza kuiambia milima, 'Angukeni juu yetu,' na vilima, 'Tufunikeni.'
sw.B: Hapo ndipo watakapoanza kuiambia milima, 'Angukeni juu yetu!' na vilima, 'Tufunikeni!'
sw.R: Watu wataiita milima, 'Tuangukieni!' Watavililia vilima, 'Tufunikeni kabisa!'

vi.L: Bấy giờ người ta sẽ bắt đầu nói với các núi: 'Hãy đổ xuống trên chúng tôi,' và với các đồi: 'Hãy che lấp chúng tôi.'
vi.B: Lúc ấy người ta sẽ bắt đầu nói với núi: 'Hãy đổ xuống đè lên chúng tôi!' và nói với đồi: 'Hãy che lấp chúng tôi!'
vi.R: Người ta sẽ kêu với núi: 'Hãy sập xuống đè lên chúng tôi!' Họ sẽ kêu với đồi: 'Hãy chôn vùi chúng tôi đi!'

ko.L: 그때에 사람들이 산들에게 '우리 위에 무너져라' 하고, 언덕들에게 '우리를 덮어라' 하고 말하기 시작할 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 사람들은 산을 향해 '우리 위에 무너져 내려라!' 하고, 언덕을 향해 '우리를 덮어라!' 하고 말하기 시작할 것이다.
ko.R: 사람들이 산들을 향해 '우리 위로 무너져라!' 하고 외칠 것이다. 언덕들을 향해서는 '우리를 덮어 버려라!' 하고 소리칠 것이다.

decisions.choice: the words of Hosea 10:8
decisions.reason: Hosea foretold that when judgment came on Samaria, people would beg the mountains to cover them and the hills to fall on them. Revelation 6:16 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: Fall on us ... Cover us: a wish to die rather than face what is coming
decisions.reason: The cry asks for death, or to be hidden from the judgment, because it is too terrible to bear.

decisions.choice: a raised dot: the reason follows in 23:31
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT marks a pause; Jesus' explanation follows in the next sentence.

source.text: ὅτι εἰ ἐν τῷ ὑγρῷ ξύλῳ ταῦτα ποιοῦσιν, ἐν τῷ ξηρῷ τί γένηται;

records.literal_gloss: For if in the green wood these things they do, in the dry what may happen?

en.L: For if they do these things in the green wood, what will happen in the dry?"
en.B: For if this is how they treat wood that is green, what will become of wood that is dry?"
en.R: If this is what they do to a tree that is green and growing, what will happen to a tree that is dry?"

es.L: Porque si en el leño verde hacen estas cosas, en el seco ¿qué sucederá?».
es.B: Porque si así tratan a la madera verde, ¿qué será de la seca?».
es.R: Si esto le hacen a un árbol verde y lleno de vida, ¿qué pasará con un árbol seco?».

fr.L: Car s’ils font ces choses au bois vert, au sec, qu’arrivera-t-il ? »
fr.B: Car s’ils traitent ainsi le bois vert, que deviendra le bois sec ? »
fr.R: Si c’est ce qu’ils font à un arbre vert et plein de vie, qu’est-ce qui va arriver à un arbre sec ? »

sw.L: Kwa maana kama katika mti mbichi wanafanya haya, katika ule mkavu kutatokea nini?"
sw.B: Kwa maana ikiwa wanautendea hivi mti ulio mbichi, mti ulio mkavu utapatwa na nini?"
sw.R: Kama wanautendea hivi mti mbichi unaoendelea kukua, mti mkavu utakuwaje?"

vi.L: Vì nếu người ta làm những điều này với cây gỗ xanh, thì với cây khô sẽ ra sao?"
vi.B: Vì nếu người ta đối xử với cây còn xanh như thế, thì cây khô sẽ ra thế nào?"
vi.R: Nếu người ta làm như thế với một cây đang xanh tươi, thì một cây khô sẽ bị gì?"

ko.L: 그들이 푸른 나무에 이런 일들을 한다면, 마른 [나무]에는 무슨 일이 일어나겠느냐?"
ko.B: 푸른 나무에도 이렇게 한다면, 마른 나무는 어떻게 되겠느냐?"
ko.R: 푸르게 살아 있는 나무에도 이렇게 한다면, 마른 나무에는 어떤 일이 일어나겠느냐?"

decisions.choice: green wood and dry: if the innocent suffers like this, the guilty will suffer far worse
alternatives: if the Romans treat Jesus so, they will treat the rebel city worse
if the people do this now, what will they do later
decisions.reason: Green wood does not burn easily; dry wood is ready for the fire. The saying most likely means: if Jesus, who has done nothing wrong, meets such a fate, what will come on Jerusalem, which is ripe for judgment? Ezekiel 20:47 (21:3 in the Hebrew numbering) speaks of a fire that burns up every green tree and every dry tree. The proverb can be read in more than one way.

decisions.choice: they do: unclear who is meant
alternatives: a way of speaking of God's judgment
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. It may be the Romans who carry out the sentence, the leaders who demanded it, or simply people in general. Every level keeps "they".

decisions.choice: a tree that is green and growing
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture clear: a living tree as against dry, dead wood.

decisions.choice: the picture of green and dry wood kept at every level
decisions.reason: The saying's sense is footnoted in the meaning decision; Vietnamese keeps the picture rather than explaining it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: [나무]
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the dry" with the noun understood; Korean needs it.

source.text: Ἤγοντο δὲ καὶ ἕτεροι κακοῦργοι δύο σὺν αὐτῷ ἀναιρεθῆναι.

records.literal_gloss: Were being led now also others criminals two with him to be put to death.

en.L: And two others, criminals, were also being led away with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be put to death.
en.B: Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be executed.
en.R: Two other men were also being taken out to be killed with Jesus. They were criminals.

es.L: Y eran llevados también otros dos, malhechores, con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} para ser ejecutados.
es.B: También llevaban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} a otros dos hombres, ambos malhechores, para ejecutarlos.
es.R: También llevaban a otros dos hombres para matarlos junto con Jesús. Eran criminales.

fr.L: Et deux autres, des malfaiteurs, étaient aussi conduits avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour être mis à mort.
fr.B: Deux autres hommes, des malfaiteurs, furent aussi emmenés avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour être exécutés.
fr.R: On emmenait aussi deux autres hommes pour les faire mourir avec Jésus. C’étaient des criminels.

sw.L: Na wengine wawili, wahalifu, walikuwa wakiongozwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ili wauawe.
sw.B: Watu wengine wawili, wote wahalifu, walipelekwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ili wauawe.
sw.R: Watu wengine wawili pia walikuwa wakipelekwa kuuawa pamoja na Yesu. Walikuwa wahalifu.

vi.L: Họ cũng dẫn hai người khác, là những kẻ gian ác, đi cùng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để bị xử tử.
vi.B: Có hai người khác, đều là tội phạm, cũng bị dẫn đi cùng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để xử tử.
vi.R: Có hai người khác cũng bị đem đi giết cùng với Đức Giê-xu. Họ là những tội phạm.

ko.L: 그리고 다른 두 사람, 곧 범죄자들도 그분과 함께 처형되려고 끌려가고 있었다.
ko.B: 다른 두 사람도 처형되려고 예수와 함께 끌려갔다. 그들은 범죄자들이었다.
ko.R: 다른 두 사람도 예수와 함께 죽임을 당하려고 끌려가고 있었다. 그들은 범죄자들이었다.

decisions.choice: two others, criminals: Jesus is not called a criminal
alternatives: two other criminals, as if Jesus were one too
decisions.reason: The Greek can be read word by word as "other criminals, two", but the sense is "two others, who were criminals". Every level avoids suggesting that Jesus was one of them.

decisions.choice: with him: counted among the lawless
decisions.reason: At the supper Jesus quoted Isaiah 53:12, that he would be counted with the lawless, and said it must be fulfilled in him (22:37).

decisions.choice: criminals: those who do evil
decisions.reason: The word means evildoers. Mark 15:27 uses a word for bandits or rebels.

decisions.choice: malhechores (L, B); criminales (R); the word kept apart from "otros dos" by a comma or a separate clause
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a doer of evil, a criminal (meaning decision m3), not Mark's word for bandits ("bandidos"). "Malhechor" says exactly that; Readable uses the everyday "criminales", as the English does. Every level keeps "otros dos" separate from "malhechores", so Jesus is not called a criminal (meaning decision m1). The same in 23:33 and 23:39.

decisions.choice: wahalifu (every level), kept apart from "wengine wawili"
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a doer of evil, a criminal (meaning decision m3), not Mark's word for armed robbers ("majambazi"). "Mhalifu" is the standard word for a lawbreaker. Every level keeps "wengine wawili" separate from "wahalifu", so Jesus is not called a criminal (meaning decision m1). The same in 23:33 and 23:39.

decisions.choice: "những kẻ gian ác" (L); "tội phạm" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke's word means evildoers; "kẻ cướp" belongs to Mark's different word. The order "hai người khác, là ..." keeps Jesus out of the class of criminals (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "범죄자" for kakourgos at every level, through chapter 23; "다른 두 사람" first
decisions.reason: Luke's word means one who does evil; "강도" stays for lestes (Mark 15:27). Naming the two as "other" men first and then calling them criminals keeps Jesus out of that word (meaning decision).

source.text: καὶ ὅτε ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον Κρανίον, ἐκεῖ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς κακούργους, ὃν μὲν ἐκ δεξιῶν ὃν δὲ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And when they came to the place the [one] called Skull, there they crucified him and the criminals, one on [the] right one and on [the] left.

en.L: And when they came to the place called "Skull," there they crucified {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and the criminals, one on [the] right and one on [the] left.
en.B: When they reached the place called the Skull, they crucified {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} there, with the criminals, one at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand and one at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left.
en.R: They came to a place called The Skull. There the soldiers nailed Jesus to a cross. They also nailed the two criminals to crosses, one on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right side and one on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left.

es.L: Y cuando llegaron al lugar llamado «Calavera», allí {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} crucificaron, a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y a los malhechores, uno a [la] derecha y otro a [la] izquierda.
es.B: Cuando llegaron al lugar llamado la Calavera, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} crucificaron allí junto con los malhechores, uno a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha y otro a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda.
es.R: Llegaron a un lugar llamado La Calavera. Allí los soldados clavaron a Jesús en una cruz. También clavaron en cruces a los dos criminales, uno a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha y otro a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda.

fr.L: Et quand ils arrivèrent au lieu appelé « Crâne », là ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} crucifièrent, ainsi que les malfaiteurs, l’un à droite et l’autre à gauche.
fr.B: Lorsqu’ils furent arrivés au lieu appelé le Crâne, ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} crucifièrent là, avec les malfaiteurs, l’un à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et l’autre à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche.
fr.R: Ils sont arrivés à un endroit appelé le Crâne. Là, les soldats ont cloué Jésus sur une croix. Ils ont aussi cloué les deux criminels sur des croix, l’un à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et l’autre à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche.

sw.L: Na walipofika mahali paitwapo "Fuvu," hapo walimsulubisha {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} na wale wahalifu, mmoja upande wa kulia na mmoja upande wa kushoto.
sw.B: Walipofika mahali panapoitwa Fuvu, walimsulubisha pale pamoja na wale wahalifu, mmoja upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na mwingine upande wa kushoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Walifika mahali panapoitwa Fuvu. Hapo askari walimpigilia Yesu misumari msalabani. Wakawapigilia pia wale wahalifu wawili kwenye misalaba, mmoja upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na mwingine upande wa kushoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Khi đến nơi gọi là Cái Sọ, tại đó họ đóng đinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và những kẻ gian ác, một kẻ bên phải và một kẻ bên trái.
vi.B: Khi đến nơi gọi là Cái Sọ, họ đóng đinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại đó, cùng với hai tội phạm, một tên bên phải và một tên bên trái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ đến một nơi gọi là Cái Sọ. Ở đó những người lính đóng đinh Đức Giê-xu trên cây thập tự. Họ cũng đóng đinh hai tội phạm, một tên ở bên phải và một tên ở bên trái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 해골이라고 불리는 곳에 이르러, 거기서 그분과 범죄자들을 십자가에 못 박았다. 한 사람은 오른쪽에, 한 사람은 왼쪽에 [못 박았다].
ko.B: 해골이라고 하는 곳에 이르자, 그들은 거기서 예수를 십자가에 못 박고, 범죄자들도 하나는 예수의 오른쪽에, 하나는 왼쪽에 못 박았다.
ko.R: 그들은 '해골'이라고 불리는 곳에 이르렀다. 거기서 병사들은 예수를 십자가에 못 박았다. 그리고 그 두 범죄자도 십자가에 못 박았다. 한 사람은 예수의 오른쪽에, 다른 한 사람은 왼쪽에 있었다.

decisions.choice: Skull: the place of execution outside the city
decisions.reason: Mark 15:22 and John 19:17 give its Aramaic name, Golgotha, which means skull; the Latin word for skull gave the name Calvary. Why it was so called is not known. It was outside the city wall (John 19:20; Hebrews 13:12).

decisions.choice: they crucified him: Luke tells it in a single word
decisions.reason: Luke does not describe the nailing or the suffering. The bare word says all that his readers needed to know.

decisions.choice: one on the right and one on the left: Jesus in the middle
alternatives: a detail of no further meaning
decisions.reason: Placed between two criminals, Jesus is counted with the lawless, as he had said (22:37; Isaiah 53:12).

decisions.choice: his right ... his left
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose right and left is meant.

decisions.choice: the soldiers nailed Jesus to a cross
decisions.reason: Readable explains crucifixion and names who did it (23:36).

decisions.choice: Calavera (every level)
decisions.reason: Luke gives only the Greek name, "Skull" (meaning decision m1), and not the Aramaic "Golgotha" that Matthew, Mark and John add. Spanish says "Calavera", the word Mark 15:22 uses for its meaning; "Calvario" comes from the Latin and is not in the Greek.

decisions.choice: Fuvu (every level)
decisions.reason: Luke gives only the Greek name, "Skull" (meaning decision m1), and not the Aramaic "Golgotha" that Matthew, Mark and John add. Swahili says "Fuvu", the word Mark 15:22 uses for its meaning; "Kalvari" comes from the Latin and is not in the Greek.

decisions.choice: "Cái Sọ"
decisions.reason: Luke gives only the Greek name, so Vietnamese translates it, as the Vietnamese Mark 15:22 does after the Aramaic; "Đồi Sọ" would add a hill the text does not mention.

en.L: And Jesus was saying, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing."
en.B: Jesus kept saying, "Father, forgive them. They do not know what they are doing."
en.R: Jesus said, "Father, forgive these people. They do not understand what they are doing."

es.L: Y Jesús decía: «Padre, perdónalos, pues no saben qué hacen».
es.B: Jesús repetía: «Padre, perdónalos. No saben lo que están haciendo».
es.R: Jesús dijo: «Padre, perdona a esta gente. No entienden lo que están haciendo».

fr.L: Et Jésus disait : « Père, pardonne-leur, car ils ne savent pas ce qu’ils font. »
fr.B: Jésus répétait : « Père, pardonne-leur. Ils ne savent pas ce qu’ils font. »

sw.L: Naye Yesu alikuwa akisema, "Baba, wasamehe, kwa maana hawajui wanalofanya."
sw.B: Yesu aliendelea kusema, "Baba, wasamehe. Hawajui wanachofanya."
sw.R: Yesu alisema, "Baba, uwasamehe watu hawa. Hawaelewi wanachofanya."

vi.L: Còn Đức Giê-xu thì nói: "Lạy Cha, xin tha cho họ, vì họ không biết điều họ đang làm."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu cứ nói: "Lạy Cha, xin tha thứ cho họ, vì họ không biết việc họ đang làm."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cầu nguyện: "Lạy Cha, xin tha thứ cho những người này. Họ không hiểu việc mình đang làm."

ko.L: 그런데 예수께서 말씀하고 계셨다. "아버지, 저들을 용서해 주십시오. 저들은 자기들이 무엇을 하는지 알지 못합니다."
ko.B: 예수께서 거듭 말씀하셨다. "아버지, 저 사람들을 용서해 주십시오. 저들은 자기들이 무엇을 하는지 알지 못합니다."
ko.R: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "아버지, 이 사람들을 용서해 주십시오. 이 사람들은 자기들이 무슨 일을 하는지 모릅니다."

decisions.choice: the prayer is included, as in the SBLGNT
alternatives: the prayer is left out, as in several early manuscripts
decisions.reason: The prayer is missing from the early papyrus P75, Codex Vaticanus, the first hand of Codex Bezae, Codex Washingtonianus and the Sinaitic Syriac, and a corrector of Codex Sinaiticus marked it for removal. It is found in the first hand of Codex Sinaiticus, in Codex Alexandrinus and Codex Ephraemi, and in most later manuscripts, and early church writers knew it. It fits Luke's own themes: Stephen prays in the same way as he dies (Acts 7:60), and Peter tells the people of Jerusalem that they acted in ignorance (Acts 3:17). Some think it was left out by copyists who thought the fall of Jerusalem showed the prayer had not been answered; others think it is an old saying of Jesus added here. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: was saying: said, or kept saying
decisions.reason: The verb is imperfect. It may mean that Jesus prayed this more than once, or simply set the scene for his words.

decisions.choice: them: those who were putting him to death
decisions.reason: The word is not limited. It includes the soldiers who were crucifying him and may reach to all who had a part in his death, who acted without knowing what they did (Acts 3:17; 13:27).

decisions.choice: Father: Jesus prays to God as his Father
decisions.reason: Jesus addresses God as Father in prayer (10:21; 22:42) and does so again with his last words (23:46).

decisions.choice: "Lạy Cha"
decisions.reason: Jesus' address to the Father in prayer, as in the Vietnamese Luke 10:21 and 11:2; "Cha" is a noun of address and takes no setting span.

decisions.choice: Jesus prays to the Father in 합쇼체 ("용서해 주십시오", "알지 못합니다"), here and in 23:46
decisions.reason: As Jesus prays to the Father in the Korean John 17 and Mark 15:34 (style guide, section 4).

records.literal_gloss: Dividing then the garments of him they cast lots.

en.L: And dividing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clothes, they cast lots.
en.B: They shared out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clothes among themselves by casting lots.
en.R: The soldiers divided {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clothes among themselves. They threw lots to decide who would get each piece.

es.L: Y, repartiéndose {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ropas, echaron suertes.
es.B: Se repartieron {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ropa echando suertes.
es.R: Los soldados se repartieron {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ropa. Echaron suertes para decidir quién se llevaría cada prenda.

fr.L: Et, partageant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} vêtements, ils jetèrent les sorts.
fr.B: Ils se partagèrent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} vêtements en tirant au sort.

sw.L: Na wakigawana mavazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, walitupa kura.
sw.B: Waligawana nguo {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa kutupa kura.
sw.R: Askari waligawana nguo {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Waliamua kwa bahati ni nani atachukua kila nguo.

vi.L: Và chia nhau áo xống của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, họ bắt thăm.
vi.B: Họ bắt thăm để chia nhau quần áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những người lính chia nhau quần áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ bắt thăm để định ai được món nào.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그분의 옷을 나누면서 제비를 뽑았다.
ko.B: 그들은 제비를 뽑아 예수의 옷을 나누어 가졌다.
ko.R: 병사들은 예수의 옷을 자기들끼리 나누어 가졌다. 누가 어느 옷을 가질지 제비를 뽑아 정했다.

decisions.choice: dividing his clothes and casting lots: the words of Psalm 22
alternatives: a detail of no further meaning
decisions.reason: Psalm 22:19 says of the sufferer, "they divide my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots." John 19:24 names the psalm.

decisions.choice: casting lots: deciding by chance
decisions.reason: Lots were marked stones or pieces of wood shaken out, much like dice. The clothes of an executed man went to those who carried out the sentence.

decisions.choice: The soldiers
decisions.reason: Readable names who divided the clothes; Luke mentions them in 23:36.

decisions.choice: kutupa kura (L, B); kuamua kwa bahati (R)
decisions.reason: Lots let chance decide who got each garment (meaning decision m2). "Kupiga kura" today usually means to vote, so Literal and Balanced say "kutupa kura" and Readable "decide by chance", as in Mark 15:24 and John 19:24.

decisions.choice: "bắt thăm" at every level
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:24 and John 19:24: the plain word for deciding by lot, which keeps the echo of Psalm 22.

decisions.choice: "제비를 뽑다" at every level
decisions.reason: The words of the Korean Mark 15:24 and John 19:24, and of Psalm 22 that the verse echoes.

es.B: El pueblo estaba allí contemplándolo todo.
es.R: La gente estaba allí mirando.

fr.L: Et le peuple se tenait debout, regardant.
fr.B: Le peuple restait là à regarder.
fr.R: Les gens étaient là, debout, et ils regardaient.

sw.B: Watu walisimama pale wakitazama.

vi.B: Dân chúng đứng đó xem.
vi.R: Dân chúng đứng đó nhìn.

decisions.choice: watching: looking on as at a spectacle
decisions.reason: The verb means to look at or watch. Luke does not say that the people mocked; he keeps the mocking for the rulers, the soldiers and one criminal.

decisions.choice: the people stood watching: those who see the sufferer in Psalm 22
alternatives: a detail of no further meaning
decisions.reason: Psalm 22:8 speaks of all who see the sufferer and sneer at him. Luke uses the verbs of that verse here and in the next sentence.

source.text: ἐξεμυκτήριζον δὲ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες λέγοντες· Ἄλλους ἔσωσεν, σωσάτω ἑαυτόν, εἰ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ ἐκλεκτός.

records.literal_gloss: Were sneering then also the rulers saying, Others he saved, let him save himself, if this is the Christ of the God, the chosen.

en.L: And the rulers also were sneering, saying, "He saved others; let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} save {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, if this is the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} of God, the Chosen One."
en.B: The rulers joined in the scoffing. "He saved others," they said. "So let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} save {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, if this man is God's {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, the one God chose."
en.R: The leaders laughed at {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} too. They said, "He saved other people. Let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} save {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} now, if {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} really is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} whom God sent, the one God has chosen!"

es.L: Y también los dirigentes se mofaban, diciendo: «A otros salvó; que se salve a {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo, si este es el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} de Dios, el Escogido».
es.B: También los dirigentes se burlaban: «Salvó a otros», decían. «Pues que se salve a {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo, si este es el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} de Dios, el que Dios escogió».
es.R: Los líderes también se reían de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Decían: «Salvó a otras personas. ¡Que se salve ahora a {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo, si de verdad es el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} que Dios envió, el que Dios ha escogido!».

fr.L: Et les dirigeants aussi ricanaient, disant : « Il a sauvé les autres ; qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se sauve {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, si celui-ci est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} de Dieu, l’Élu ! »
fr.B: Les dirigeants, eux aussi, se moquaient de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. « Il a sauvé les autres, disaient-ils. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se sauve donc {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, si cet homme est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} de Dieu, celui que Dieu a choisi ! »
fr.R: Les chefs se moquaient de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, eux aussi. Ils disaient : « Il a sauvé d’autres gens. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se sauve {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} maintenant, si c’est vraiment {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} envoyé par Dieu, celui que Dieu a choisi ! »

sw.L: Na viongozi nao walikuwa wakimbeza, wakisema, "Aliwaokoa wengine; na ajiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, ikiwa huyu ndiye {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wa Mungu, Mteule."
sw.B: Viongozi nao walimdhihaki. "Aliwaokoa wengine," walisema. "Basi na ajiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, ikiwa mtu huyu ndiye {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wa Mungu, yule ambaye Mungu alimchagua."
sw.R: Viongozi nao walimcheka. Walisema, "Aliwaokoa watu wengine. Basi ajiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} sasa, ikiwa kweli {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} aliyetumwa na Mungu, yule ambaye Mungu amemchagua!"

vi.L: Còn các nhà lãnh đạo cũng chế nhạo mà nói: "Ông ta đã cứu những người khác; hãy để ông ta tự cứu mình đi, nếu người này là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} của Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng được chọn!"
vi.B: Các nhà lãnh đạo cũng buông lời nhạo báng: "Ông ta đã cứu người khác. Nếu người này đúng là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} của Đức Chúa Trời, người được Đức Chúa Trời chọn, thì hãy để ông ta tự cứu mình đi!"
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo cũng cười nhạo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ nói: "Ông ta đã cứu người khác. Nếu ông ta thật là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} mà Đức Chúa Trời sai đến, là người Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn, thì bây giờ hãy để ông ta tự cứu mình đi!"

ko.L: 그리고 지도자들도 비웃으며 말했다. "그가 남들은 구원했다. 이자가 하나님의 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, 곧 택함을 받은 자라면, 자기 자신을 구원하라."
ko.B: 지도자들도 비웃으며 말했다. "남들은 구원하더니! 이자가 하나님의 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, 하나님께서 택하신 자라면 자기 자신이나 구원해 보라지!"
ko.R: 지도자들도 예수를 비웃었다. 그들이 말했다. "다른 사람들은 구해 주더니! 이 사람이 정말 하나님께서 보내신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이고 하나님께서 택하신 사람이라면, 이제 자기 자신이나 구해 보라지!"

decisions.choice: sneering: turning up the nose in scorn
decisions.reason: The verb pictures a sneer of contempt. It is the verb of the Greek version of Psalm 22:8, where those who see the sufferer sneer at him.

decisions.choice: He saved others; let him save himself: mockery that says more than it means
decisions.reason: Jesus had saved others: he healed the sick and forgave sinners, and came to seek and to save the lost (7:50; 19:10). The rulers think that one who cannot save himself cannot be the Christ; Luke's readers know that he saves others by not saving himself.

decisions.choice: the Christ of God, the Chosen One: God's anointed King, the one he has chosen
decisions.reason: Peter called Jesus "the Christ of God" (9:20), and the voice from the cloud called him "my Son, the chosen one" (9:35), recalling God's chosen servant of Isaiah 42:1. The rulers use the titles to mock him.

decisions.choice: this: said with contempt
decisions.reason: The rulers do not name Jesus; "this one" keeps him at a distance.

decisions.choice: they said
decisions.reason: Balanced places the speaker words inside the quotation, which reads more naturally.

decisions.choice: God's Christ / the Christ of God, with Messiah as the alternative
decisions.reason: The title follows the christos setting; Balanced uses the possessive form as at 9:20.

decisions.choice: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} de Dios, with the article outside the span
alternatives: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} de Dios (B, as the English "God's Christ")
decisions.reason: The leaders use the word as a title, "the Christ of God" (meaning decision m3). Spanish keeps the article with the title at every level, so the setting changes only the noun, as the term sheet sets for "Cristo" used as a title and as in Mark 15:32.

decisions.choice: le Christ de Dieu (B), with Messie as the alternative
decisions.reason: French has no possessive form like the English "God's Christ", so Balanced keeps "le Christ de Dieu", as Literal does; the title stays under the christos setting.

decisions.choice: "Ông ta ... mình", "người này" with no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:31: the leaders speak of Jesus as "ông ta", and "mình" is a plain reflexive; neither has a reverent capital form.

decisions.choice: "구원하다" (L, B), "구하다" (R) for sozo, here and in 23:37 and 23:39; mockers give Jesus no honorific; a scornful third-person command, "구원하라" (L), "-해 보라지" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 15:31-32: the scorn says more than it means (meaning decision), so "구원하다" keeps the word of salvation. The particles after the christos span fit both forms.

source.text: ἐνέπαιξαν δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ στρατιῶται προσερχόμενοι, ὄξος προσφέροντες αὐτῷ καὶ λέγοντες· Εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων, σῶσον σεαυτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Mocked then him also the soldiers coming near, sour wine offering him \v 37 and saying, If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself.

en.L: And the soldiers also mocked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, coming up [and] offering {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} sour wine \v 37 and saying, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the king of the Jews, save {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}!"
en.B: The soldiers made fun of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as well. They came up and held out sour wine to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 37 saying, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the king of the Jews, save {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}!"
en.R: The soldiers made fun of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} too. They came close and offered {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} some cheap sour wine. \v 37 They said, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the king of the Jews, then save {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}!"

es.L: Y también los soldados se burlaban de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, acercándose [y] ofreciéndole vino agrio \v 37 y diciendo: «Si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Rey de los judíos, sálvate a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo».
es.B: También los soldados se burlaron de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Se acercaban y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ofrecían vino agrio, \v 37 diciendo: «¡Si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Rey de los judíos, sálvate a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo!».
es.R: Los soldados también se burlaron de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Se acercaron y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ofrecieron vino agrio barato. \v 37 Le dijeron: «¡Si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el rey de los judíos, entonces sálvate a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo!».

fr.L: Et les soldats aussi se moquèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, s’approchant [et] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} présentant du vin aigre, \v 37 et disant : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le roi des Juifs, sauve-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} {{deity_pronoun:toi-même|Toi-même}} ! »
fr.B: Les soldats aussi se moquèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Ils s’approchaient et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} tendaient du vin aigre, \v 37 en disant : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le roi des Juifs, sauve-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} {{deity_pronoun:toi-même|Toi-même}} ! »
fr.R: Les soldats aussi se sont moqués de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Ils se sont approchés et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont présenté du vin aigre bon marché. \v 37 Ils ont dit : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le roi des Juifs, alors sauve-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! »

sw.L: Na askari nao walimdhihaki, wakimkaribia, wakimpa divai chungu \v 37 na kusema, "Ikiwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mfalme wa Wayahudi, jiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}!"
sw.B: Askari nao walimfanyia mzaha. Walimkaribia, wakimpa divai chungu, \v 37 wakisema, "Ikiwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mfalme wa Wayahudi, jiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}!"
sw.R: Askari nao walimfanyia mzaha. Walimkaribia, wakampa divai chungu ya bei rahisi. \v 37 Wakasema, "Kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mfalme wa Wayahudi, basi jiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}!"

vi.L: Các binh lính cũng chế nhạo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đến gần, đưa rượu chua cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \v 37 và nói: "Nếu ông là Vua của người Do Thái, hãy tự cứu mình đi!"
vi.B: Bọn lính cũng chế giễu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ đến gần, đưa rượu chua cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \v 37 và nói: "Nếu ông là Vua dân Do Thái thì hãy tự cứu mình đi!"
vi.R: Những người lính cũng chế giễu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ đến gần và đưa cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rượu chua rẻ tiền. \v 37 Họ nói: "Nếu ông là vua của dân Do Thái thì hãy tự cứu mình đi!"

ko.L: 그리고 병사들도 다가와서 그분께 신 포도주를 내밀며 조롱하여 \v 37 말했다. "네가 유대인의 왕이면 너 자신을 구원하여라."
ko.B: 병사들도 예수를 조롱했다. 그들은 다가와서 예수께 신 포도주를 내밀며 \v 37 말했다. "네가 유대인의 왕이라면 너 자신이나 구원해 보아라!"
ko.R: 병사들도 예수를 놀렸다. 그들은 가까이 와서 값싼 신 포도주를 예수께 내밀었다. \v 37 그리고 말했다. "네가 유대인의 왕이라면, 너 자신이나 구해 보아라!"

decisions.choice: sour wine: the cheap, vinegary wine soldiers drank
decisions.reason: The word is for wine that has turned sour, a common drink of soldiers and laborers. Here it is offered in mockery.

decisions.choice: offering him sour wine: the words of Psalm 69
decisions.reason: Psalm 69:22 says of the sufferer, "for my thirst they gave me sour wine to drink."

decisions.choice: If you are: said in scorn
decisions.reason: The soldiers assume he is not a king. The words echo the devil's "If you are the Son of God" (4:3, 9).

decisions.choice: cheap sour wine
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of drink this was.

decisions.choice: du vin aigre
decisions.reason: As in Mark 15:36: the drink was cheap wine gone sour (m1), which soldiers drank; French "vinaigre" today means only the condiment.

decisions.choice: the soldiers address Jesus as "ông" and say "tự cứu mình", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Mockers speak to Jesus as "ông", as the passers-by do in the Vietnamese Mark 15:29; the reflexive "mình" is not a pronoun of respect.

decisions.choice: "rượu chua"
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:36 and John 19:29: "giấm" today means cooking vinegar.

decisions.choice: "신 포도주" at every level
decisions.reason: The word of the Korean Mark 15:36 and John 19:29; "초" (vinegar) misleads, since it was cheap wine gone sour.

source.text: ἦν δὲ καὶ ἐπιγραφὴ ἐπ’ αὐτῷ· Ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων οὗτος.

records.literal_gloss: There was now also an inscription over him, The king of the Jews this.

en.L: And there was also an inscription over {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: "This [is] the king of the Jews."
en.B: Above {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} there was also a written notice: "This is the king of the Jews."
en.R: A notice had been put up above {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head. It said, "This is the king of the Jews."

es.L: Y había también una inscripción sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}: «Este [es] el Rey de los judíos».
es.B: Sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había también un letrero escrito: «Este es el Rey de los judíos».
es.R: Encima de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza habían puesto un letrero. Decía: «Este es el rey de los judíos».

fr.L: Et il y avait aussi une inscription au-dessus de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} : « Celui-ci [est] le roi des Juifs. »
fr.B: Au-dessus de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, il y avait aussi un écriteau : « Celui-ci est le roi des Juifs. »
fr.R: On avait mis un écriteau au-dessus de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tête. Il disait : « Voici le roi des Juifs. »

sw.L: Na palikuwa pia na maandishi juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}: "Huyu [ndiye] Mfalme wa Wayahudi."
sw.B: Juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kulikuwa pia na tangazo lililoandikwa, "Huyu ndiye Mfalme wa Wayahudi."
sw.R: Juu ya kichwa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} walikuwa wameweka kibao. Kiliandikwa, "Huyu ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi."

vi.L: Phía trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng có một bản ghi: "Người này [là] Vua của người Do Thái."
vi.B: Phía trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng có một tấm bảng ghi: "Đây là Vua dân Do Thái."
vi.R: Người ta đã treo một tấm bảng phía trên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Trên đó ghi: "Đây là vua của dân Do Thái."

ko.L: 그리고 그분 위에는 "이 사람은 유대인의 왕이다"라고 쓴 패도 있었다.
ko.B: 예수의 위쪽에는 "이 사람은 유대인의 왕이다"라고 쓴 패도 붙어 있었다.
ko.R: 예수의 머리 위에는 팻말도 붙어 있었다. 거기에는 "이 사람은 유대인의 왕이다"라고 쓰여 있었다.

decisions.choice: an inscription: the charge written on a board
decisions.reason: The charge against a condemned man was written on a board and carried before him or fixed to the cross, so that all could read why he died (John 19:19-20).

decisions.choice: an inscription over him: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: an inscription written over him in Greek, Latin and Hebrew letters, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add that the notice was written in Greek, Latin and Hebrew, words probably taken from John 19:20. The early papyrus P75, Codex Vaticanus and others do not have them. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the king of the Jews: a mocking charge that states the truth
decisions.reason: The notice was meant to mock and to warn, but Luke's readers know that Jesus is the King promised to sit on David's throne (1:32-33; 19:38).

decisions.choice: above his head
decisions.reason: Readable says where the notice was placed.

decisions.choice: "쓴 패" (L, B); "팻말" (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's word is "inscription", without Mark's "of the charge", so Korean does not use "죄패" (Mark 15:26 Balanced); Readable uses the everyday word, as in Mark.

source.text: Εἷς δὲ τῶν κρεμασθέντων κακούργων ἐβλασφήμει αὐτόν λέγων· Οὐχὶ σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστός;

records.literal_gloss: One now of the having been hanged criminals was insulting him saying, Not you are the Christ?

en.L: And one of the criminals who had been hanged [there] kept insulting {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}?
en.B: One of the criminals hanging beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} kept abusing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. "You are {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not?
en.R: One of the criminals hanging there began to say cruel things to Jesus. He said, "You are {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not?

es.L: Y uno de los malhechores colgados [allí] {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} injuriaba, diciendo: «¿No eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}?
es.B: Uno de los malhechores que estaban colgados junto a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} insultaba: «Tú eres el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, ¿no es así?
es.R: Uno de los criminales que estaban colgados allí empezó a decirle cosas crueles a Jesús. Le dijo: «Tú eres el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, ¿no?

fr.L: Et l’un des malfaiteurs qui étaient suspendus [là] {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}insultait, disant : « N’es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ?
fr.B: L’un des malfaiteurs suspendus à côté de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}injuriait : « Tu es le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, n’est-ce pas ?
fr.R: L’un des criminels qui étaient sur les croix a commencé à dire des choses méchantes à Jésus. Il a dit : « Tu es le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, n’est-ce pas ?

sw.L: Na mmoja wa wale wahalifu waliotundikwa [huko] alikuwa akimtukana, akisema, "Je, si {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}?
sw.B: Mmoja wa wale wahalifu waliotundikwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} alikuwa akimtukana: "Wewe ndiwe {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, sivyo?
sw.R: Mmoja wa wale wahalifu waliotundikwa pale alianza kumwambia Yesu maneno ya kikatili. Alisema, "Wewe ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, sivyo?

vi.L: Một trong những kẻ gian ác bị treo [trên cây thập tự] cứ nhục mạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà nói: "Ông không phải là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sao?
vi.B: Một trong hai tên tội phạm bị treo bên cạnh cứ sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Ông là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} kia mà, phải không?
vi.R: Một trong hai tên tội phạm bị treo ở đó bắt đầu nói những lời độc ác với Đức Giê-xu. Hắn nói: "Ông là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} phải không?

ko.L: 그런데 [십자가에] 매달린 범죄자들 가운데 하나가 그분을 모독하며 말했다. "너는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 아니냐?
ko.B: 함께 매달린 범죄자 가운데 하나가 예수께 욕설을 퍼부었다. "너는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 아니냐?
ko.R: 거기 매달린 범죄자 가운데 하나가 예수께 못된 말을 하기 시작했다. "너는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 아니냐?

decisions.choice: insulting: speaking abusively, reviling
decisions.reason: The verb is the one from which "blaspheme" comes. Spoken against a person it means to insult or revile; Luke uses it of the guards who mocked Jesus (22:65).

decisions.choice: Are you not the Christ: a question that expects yes, said in scorn
decisions.reason: The form of the question expects agreement, but the man means it as a taunt, as the demand that follows shows.

decisions.choice: hanged: hanging on a cross
decisions.reason: Crucifixion could be spoken of as hanging on a tree (Acts 5:30; 10:39; Galatians 3:13, recalling Deuteronomy 21:23).

decisions.choice: You are the Christ, are you not?
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the expected answer plain.

decisions.choice: the criminal addresses Jesus as "ông", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: He mocks Jesus as the other mockers do (23:37); "ông" has no capital form for the setting.

decisions.choice: "모독하다" (L), "욕설을 퍼붓다" (B), "못된 말을 하다" (R) for blasphemeo; the criminal speaks in 해라체 with "너"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 15:29; Korean "-가 아니냐?" already expects the answer yes (meaning decision), so no level needs the English reordering.

source.text: σῶσον σεαυτὸν καὶ ἡμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Save yourself and us.

en.L: Save {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} and us!"
en.B: Then save {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}, and us too!"
en.R: Then save {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}, and save us too!"

es.L: ¡Sálvate a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo y a nosotros!».
es.B: ¡Pues sálvate a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo, y a nosotros también!».
es.R: ¡Entonces sálvate a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo, y sálvanos también a nosotros!».

fr.L: Sauve-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} {{deity_pronoun:toi-même|Toi-même}}, et nous ! »
fr.B: Alors sauve-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} {{deity_pronoun:toi-même|Toi-même}}, et nous aussi ! »
fr.R: Alors sauve-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et sauve-nous aussi ! »

sw.L: Jiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} na sisi!"
sw.B: Basi jiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, na utuokoe sisi pia!"
sw.R: Basi jiokoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}! Na utuokoe sisi pia!"

vi.L: Hãy cứu chính ông và chúng tôi!"
vi.B: Vậy hãy tự cứu mình và cứu cả chúng tôi nữa đi!"
vi.R: Vậy thì hãy tự cứu mình đi, và cứu chúng tôi nữa!"

ko.L: 너 자신과 우리를 구원하여라!"
ko.B: 그렇다면 너 자신과 우리를 구원해 보아라!"
ko.R: 그렇다면 너 자신도 구하고 우리도 구해 보아라!"

decisions.choice: Save yourself: the third time the taunt is heard
decisions.reason: The rulers (23:35), the soldiers (23:37) and now a criminal all call on Jesus to save himself. He is the Savior (2:11), but he does not use his power for himself.

decisions.choice: Then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable link the demand to the question before it.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἕτερος ἐπιτιμῶν αὐτῷ ἔφη· Οὐδὲ φοβῇ σὺ τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ κρίματι εἶ;

records.literal_gloss: Answering now the other rebuking him said, Not even fear you the God, that in the same sentence you are?

en.L: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, "Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same sentence?
en.B: But the other criminal rebuked him: "Have you no fear even of God, when you are under the same sentence of death?
en.R: But the other criminal told him he was wrong. He said, "You should be afraid of God! You are being punished with the same death as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is.

es.L: Pero el otro, respondiendo y reprendiéndolo, dijo: «¿Ni siquiera temes tú a Dios, estando bajo la misma condena?
es.B: Pero el otro malhechor lo reprendió: «¿Ni siquiera a Dios le tienes miedo, tú que estás bajo la misma sentencia de muerte?
es.R: Pero el otro criminal le dijo que estaba mal lo que decía: «¡Deberías tener temor de Dios! A ti te están castigando con la misma muerte que a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Mais l’autre, répondant et le reprenant, dit : « Ne crains-tu même pas Dieu, toi, puisque tu es sous la même condamnation ?
fr.B: Mais l’autre malfaiteur le reprit : « N’as-tu donc aucune crainte de Dieu, toi qui subis la même condamnation à mort ?
fr.R: Mais l’autre criminel lui a dit qu’il avait tort. Il a dit : « Tu devrais avoir peur de Dieu ! Tu es condamné à mourir comme {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Lakini yule mwingine akajibu, na akimkemea akasema, "Wewe humwogopi hata Mungu, kwa kuwa uko katika hukumu ile ile?
sw.B: Lakini yule mhalifu mwingine alimkemea, akasema, "Je, humwogopi hata Mungu, wakati wewe uko chini ya hukumu ile ile ya kifo?
sw.R: Lakini yule mhalifu mwingine alimwambia kwamba amekosea. Akasema, "Unapaswa kumwogopa Mungu! Wewe unaadhibiwa kwa kifo kile kile kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.

vi.L: Nhưng kẻ kia đáp lại, quở trách hắn mà nói: "Anh không sợ cả Đức Chúa Trời sao, vì anh đang chịu cùng một án phạt?
vi.B: Nhưng tên kia quở trách hắn: "Anh không biết sợ Đức Chúa Trời sao, khi chính anh cũng đang chịu cùng một án tử hình?
vi.R: Nhưng tên tội phạm kia bảo hắn là hắn sai. Người ấy nói: "Anh phải biết sợ Đức Chúa Trời chứ! Anh đang bị trừng phạt bằng cái chết giống như người này.

ko.L: 그러나 다른 하나가 대답하여 그를 꾸짖으며 말했다. "너는 같은 판결을 받은 처지인데, 하나님도 두려워하지 않느냐?
ko.B: 그러자 다른 범죄자가 그를 꾸짖었다. "너도 같은 사형 선고를 받았으면서, 하나님이 두렵지도 않으냐?
ko.R: 그러나 다른 범죄자는 그가 잘못했다고 나무랐다. "너는 하나님이 두렵지도 않으냐? 너도 저분과 똑같이 죽는 벌을 받고 있지 않으냐.

decisions.choice: not even: you, of all people, should fear God
alternatives: you do not fear God either, like the mockers
decisions.reason: The word may mean that he does not even fear God, let alone respect Jesus; or that, facing death himself, he ought at least to fear God.

decisions.choice: sentence: the condemnation to death
decisions.reason: The word is for a judge's verdict. All three men are under the same sentence of crucifixion.

decisions.choice: since: the reason he should fear God
decisions.reason: The small word gives the reason: being under the same sentence, he is close to standing before God.

decisions.choice: You should be afraid of God!
alternatives: Do you not even fear God?
decisions.reason: Readable turns the rebuking question into a statement.

decisions.choice: as he is
decisions.reason: Readable says who else is under the sentence.

decisions.choice: "anh" between the two criminals
decisions.reason: Plain address between equals; "mày" would be coarse and "ngươi" archaic.

decisions.choice: "giống như người này" (R), with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The criminal speaks of Jesus to the other man as "người này", as he does in 23:41; it has no capital form.

decisions.choice: The second criminal rebukes the other in 해라체, speaks of Jesus with honour ("저분" R, 23:40; "이분" B, R, 23:41) and to him in 합쇼체 (23:42)
alternatives: no honorific for Jesus in his words
decisions.reason: His words show that he sees who Jesus is (meaning decisions), unlike the mocking criminal; Literal keeps the Greek "this man" in 23:41, as the Korean Mark 15:39 does.

source.text: καὶ ἡμεῖς μὲν δικαίως, ἄξια γὰρ ὧν ἐπράξαμεν ἀπολαμβάνομεν· οὗτος δὲ οὐδὲν ἄτοπον ἔπραξεν.

records.literal_gloss: and we indeed justly, worthy for of what we did we are receiving; this [man] however nothing out of place did.

en.L: And we indeed [are suffering] justly, for we are receiving what is deserved for what we did; but this man has done nothing out of place."
en.B: For us it is fair: we are paying the due price for what we did. But this man has done nothing amiss."
en.R: We deserve to be punished. We are getting what we earned by the things we did. But this man has not done anything wrong."

es.L: Y nosotros, en verdad, justamente [padecemos], porque recibimos lo merecido por lo que hicimos; pero este no ha hecho nada fuera de lugar».
es.B: Lo nuestro es justo: estamos pagando el precio que merecen nuestros actos. Pero este hombre no ha hecho nada indebido».
es.R: Nosotros merecemos el castigo. Estamos recibiendo lo que nos ganamos por las cosas que hicimos. Pero este hombre no ha hecho nada malo».

fr.L: Et nous, [nous subissons cela] justement, car nous recevons ce qui est dû pour ce que nous avons fait ; mais celui-ci n’a rien fait de déplacé. »
fr.B: Pour nous, c’est juste : nous payons le prix de ce que nous avons fait. Mais cet homme n’a rien fait de répréhensible. »
fr.R: Nous, nous méritons d’être punis. Nous recevons ce que nos actes méritent. Mais cet homme n’a rien fait de mal. »

sw.L: Na sisi kwa haki [tunateseka], kwa maana tunapokea kinachostahili kwa yale tuliyoyatenda; lakini huyu hakufanya lolote lisilofaa."
sw.B: Kwetu sisi ni haki: tunalipwa kile tunachostahili kwa matendo yetu. Lakini mtu huyu hajafanya kosa lolote."
sw.R: Sisi tunastahili kuadhibiwa. Tunapata kile tulichostahili kwa mambo tuliyofanya. Lakini mtu huyu hajafanya kitu chochote kibaya."

vi.L: Còn chúng ta thì [chịu] cách công bằng, vì chúng ta nhận [hình phạt] xứng với những việc chúng ta đã làm; nhưng người này không làm điều gì sai trái."
vi.B: Chúng ta bị như vậy là đúng, vì chúng ta đang lãnh hậu quả xứng đáng với việc mình đã làm. Nhưng người này chẳng làm điều gì sai cả."
